name: Topper Pack
author: Themepul

sections.description:
Topper Pack is a lightweight and easy-to-use Elementor widget collection featuring 5 essential widgets designed to boost your site’s visual appeal and user engagement.

Included Widgets:

  1. Header Info Widget – Display important header information like contact details, social links, or custom messages elegantly.
  2. Counter Widget – Animated counters to showcase stats, milestones, or achievements with smooth animations.
  3. FAQ Widget – Interactive frequently asked questions section with accordion/toggle functionality.
  4. Image Widget – Enhanced image display with responsive design and customization options.
  5. Slider Widget – Create attractive sliders and carousels for showcasing content and images.

Key Features:

  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design
  • Extensive customization options for each widget
  • Smooth animations and hover effects
  • Clean, modern interface
  • Compatible with any WordPress theme
  • Easy to use with drag-and-drop functionality
  • Optimized for performance
  • Regular updates and improvements

Perfect for businesses, portfolios, blogs, and more. Each widget is fully customizable and follows WordPress coding standards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/topper-pack directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure you have Elementor installed and activated.
  4. Your new widgets will appear inside Elementor’s widget panel under the “Topper Pack” category.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

Yes, Elementor page builder plugin is required for these widgets to function.

Are these widgets responsive?

Yes, all widgets are fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Can I customize the styles?

Absolutely! Each widget has extensive style options within Elementor’s editor.

Do these widgets slow down my site?

No, the widgets are optimized for performance and only load necessary assets.

Can I use multiple instances of the same widget?

Yes, you can use any widget multiple times on the same page or across different pages.
sections.changelog:
= 1.0.2
* Update the topper-pack.pot file

1.0.1

  • Migrated from inline scripts to proper WordPress enqueuing system using wp_enqueue_script() and wp_enqueue_style()
  • Updated all function, class, and constant names to meet WordPress.org requirements (TPP_ → TOPPPA_)
  • Resolved potential naming conflicts with other plugins by using unique 6+ character prefixes
  • Enhanced plugin namespacing for better compatibility (ep_dynamic_select → Topppa_Dynamic_Select)
  • Improved asset loading performance and WordPress compatibility
  • Updated all widget files to use consistent “topppa-” prefix naming convention
  • Enhanced security with proper nonce verification and sanitization
  • Improved error handling in asset loading
  • WordPress.org review compliance improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release
